overview_description.description: Vivid is a leading European financial platform for businesses that seamlessly integrates the management of personal and business finances. Focused on SMEs, Vivid delivers cost-effective, scalable financial solutions with best-in-class pricing, market-leading interest rates on savings and advanced business tools. Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshevand Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany’s top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Backed by Greenoaks Capital and DST Global, the company is expanding across Europe setting new standards in how businesses bank.

about_short_description.short_description: Vivid is a leading European financial platform for business that seamlessly integrates the management of personal and business finances.

product.name: Business Account
product.description: A digital business bank account offering up to 30 IBANs, enabling companies and freelancers to manage finances on a single platform with features like SEPA instant transfers and SWIFT payments.

product.name: Interest Account
product.description: An account that offers fixed annual interest rates on uninvested cash, with funds invested in qualifying money market funds for liquidity and growth.

product.name: Cards & Cashback
product.description: Provision of physical and virtual VISA cards for team members with customizable spending limits and cashback rewards on selected categories and brands.

product.name: Financing
product.description: An online loan service providing business loans up to €250,000 with a repayment term of up to 12 months, facilitated through a partner.

product.name: Invoicing
product.description: A tool to create, send, and track detailed invoices, including payment reminders, integrated within the business account platform.

product.name: Bookkeeping and Accounting Integrations
product.description: A service that organizes financial data from all bank accounts and synchronizes it with popular accounting software platforms for streamlined financial management.
